why: Second tests round for judgment slice E43 of the Effect-check sweep (missingPipeableSignature), in next/ and our tooling, under the owner's ruling that every remaining hit gets Function.dual. Recounted with only this check at error through --lspconfig over the 13 tsconfigs (nothing written to a tsconfig): 377 hits at df235a1, 167 in exam paths, 185 in product files and 25 in PR 1366's files. Fixed 148 exam-path hits and left 19. Each fix keeps the data-first call as it was. 64 plain functions were wrapped by a scratch codemod with written overload types; 22 functions with a long inferred return type keep their body under a local <name>Body const and type both overloads with ReturnType of it; 13 workflow-lint rules take Function.dual under a Rule type that now holds both overloads; the rest were written by hand. A function with an optional argument decides by a predicate on its arguments (an array, a string, a property such as grants, control or sql, Queue.isQueue, Layer.isLayer), never by count. Where the arguments cannot tell a piped call from a direct one, the optional argument became an option object: personLine, sizedLegs and e2eShard take { signer }, { plain } and { gap } beside a dual; first and loaded take one option object and need no dual; again takes (after, { id, code }) with a dual. The four Schema decoder constants (commits.ts decodeNote, decodeLink, decodeExam; Sshsig.test-support.ts decodeLine) became one-argument functions over a private decoder, since no caller passes parse options. Five CI scripts that newly import effect had a raw try/catch that fabrika/no-raw-try-catch then refused; each became Result.try with the same outcome (program.ts refusal, shard-times.ts main loop, field-check.ts parse and main, workflow-lint/shared.ts parsed, workflow-lint/scheduled.ts lintScheduled). Left: changes.mjs (9) and scheduled.mjs (6), which run before install and cannot import effect (ruling Q4 excludes them from the lock by path); effect-jsdocs.ts (3), excluded by path (ruling Q5); and plant.ts:39 (1), whose Function.dual form makes lint:promise-types refuse two Promise lines that would need new fabrika/no-promises edge lines, which this session was not allowed to add, so plant keeps its function form and waits on the lead. Product hits left for the build: 185.
